body: The 6 conservation test fixtures in `conservation_regression.rs` are copied verbatim into `e2e_conservation.rs` (grazing_fixture, feeding_fixture, mortality_senescence_fixture, trim_fixture, water_change_fixture, plus helpers close_gas_exchange, disable_dic_shortcuts, dump_trace). Extract shared fixtures into a `test_fixtures` module (e.g. `crates/tank_core/tests/common/conservation_fixtures.rs`) or a `#[cfg(test)]` module in tank_core that both test files import. This prevents silent divergence when a fixture is updated in one file but not the other.
